notes: Destard is a dragon-and-drake lair, so the set is what a dragon leaves behind: dripstone, fallen adventurers' armour and gold. The dragon hoard pieces that would have been ideal are claimed by the Hot Zone pool and the gilded suits of armour by artisan-signatures, so a gold ingot stack is the showpiece; there is no extremely rare piece left for this lair.

entries.why: Slumped skeleton, arms still raised against the wyrm.
Jewelled gold heap, a dragon's bed.
Chainmail laid out, a fallen adventurer's kit.
Agapite ingots, a rarer layer of the hoard.
Ringmail set left where its owner fell.
Gold ingot stack, the fortune a dragon sleeps on.
